This section contains documentation of input variables in a format that is easy to search and print.
The input variables are ordered alphabetically by name.
There are no subsections, just a long list of input variables that Tax-Calculator is programmed to use in its calculations.
The Availability information indicates which input data files contain the variable.
: CPS line number for the person record of the head of the tax filing unit (not used in tax-calculation logic)
: Age in years of taxpayer (i.e. primary adult)
: Age in years of spouse (i.e. secondary adult if present)
: Historical AGI category used in data extrapolation
: Filing unit’s interest payments on OBBBA-qualified auto loans
: Estimate of income on (AMT) Form 6251 but not in AGI
: 1 if unit is created primarily from IRS-SOI PUF data; 0 if created primarily from CPS data (not used in tax-calculation logic)
: 1 if claimed as dependent on another return; otherwise 0
: Wages, salaries, tips/otime for filing unit net of pension contributions
: Wages, salaries, tips/otime for taxpayer net of pension contributions (pencon_p)
: Wages, salaries, tips/otime for spouse net of pension contributions (pencon_s)
: Qualified dividends included in ordinary dividends
: Taxable refunds of state and local income taxes
: Sch C business net profit/loss for filing unit
: Sch C business net profit/loss for taxpayer
: Sch C business net profit/loss for spouse
: Capital gain distributions not reported on Sch D
: Sch E total rental, royalty, partnership, S-corporation, etc, income/loss (includes e26270 and e27200)
: Farm net income/loss for filing unit from Sch F
: Health savings account deduction from Form 8889
: Contributions to SEP, SIMPLE and qualified plans
: Penalty on early withdrawal of savings
: Retirement savings contributions credit from Form 8880
: Prior year minimum tax credit from Form 8801
: Unreported payroll taxes from Form 4137 or 8919
: Penalty tax on qualified retirement plans
: Itemizable medical and dental expenses.  WARNING: this variable is zero below the floor in PUF data.
: Itemizable state and local income/sales taxes
: Itemizable charitable giving: cash/check contributions.  WARNING: this variable is already capped in PUF data.
: Itemizable charitable giving: other than cash/check contributions.  WARNING: this variable is already capped in PUF data.
: Itemizable miscellaneous deductions.  WARNING: this variable is zero below the floor in PUF data.
: Sch D: 28% Rate Gain or Loss
: Sch E: Combined partnership and S-corporation net income/loss (includes k1bx14p and k1bx14s amounts and is included in e02000)
: Sch E: Farm rent net income or loss (included in e02000)
: Child/dependent-care expenses for qualifying persons from Form 2441
: Investment income elected amount from Form 4952
: Alternative Minimum Tax foreign tax credit from Form 6251
: Total tentative AmOppCredit amount for all students
: Adjusted qualified lifetime learning expenses for all students
: number of EIC qualifying children (range: 0 to 3)
: number of dependents age 65+ in filing unit excluding taxpayer and spouse
: 1 if Form 6251 (AMT) attached to return; otherwise 0
: CPS family identifier within household (not used in tax-calculation logic)
: FIPS state code (not used in tax-calculation logic)
: Calendar year for which taxes are calculated
: Itemizable gross (before 10% AGI disregard) casualty or theft loss
: CPS household sequence number (not used in tax-calculation logic)
: Partner self-employment earnings/loss for taxpayer (included in e26270 total)
: Partner self-employment earnings/loss for spouse (included in e26270 total)
: Filing (marital) status: line number of the checked box [1=single, 2=joint, 3=separate, 4=household-head, 5=widow(er)]
: Imputed Medicaid benefits expressed as the actuarial value of Medicaid health insurance
: Imputed Medicare benefits expressed as the actuarial value of Medicare health insurance
: 1 if separately filing spouse itemizes; otherwise 0
: Number of people age 18-20 years old in the filing unit
: Number of people 21 years old or older in the filing unit
: Number of children who are Child-Tax-Credit eligible, one condition for which is being under age 17
: Number of dependents under 6 years old
: Number of dependents under 13 years old
: Number of people under 18 years old in the filing unit
: Other tax credits (but not including Sch R credit)
: Sch D: Net short-term capital gains/losses
: Sch D: Net long-term capital gains/losses
: Contributions to defined-contribution pension plans for taxpayer
: Contributions to defined-contribution pension plans for spouse
: Filing unit’s share of total W-2 wages paid by the pass-through business
: Value of one implies business income is from a specified service trade or business (SSTB); value of zero implies business income is from a qualified trade or business
: Filing unit’s share of total business property owned by the pass-through business
: Unique numeric identifier for filing unit; appears as RECID variable in tc CLI minimal output
: Filing unit sampling weight; appears as WEIGHT variable in tc CLI minimal output
: Total number of exemptions for filing unit
